prompt_text: Donor CRM with online giving forms
response_text:
If you want a **donor CRM with online giving forms**, these platforms in the results explicitly bundle or integrate both capabilities: **GivingFuel**, **Blackbaud CRM + Online Giving**, **DonorPerfect**, **Donorbox**, **Bloomerang**, and **Givecloud**.[1][2][4][7][8][9]

A quick comparison:

| Platform | Donor CRM | Online giving forms | Notable details |
|---|---|---|---|
| **GivingFuel** | Yes | Yes | Lets staff initiate new gifts from previous donors using stored payment methods.[1] |
| **Blackbaud CRM** | Yes | Yes | Donation forms connect gifts into Blackbaud CRM, with donor matching and automated daily batch processing.[2] |
| **DonorPerfect** | Yes | Yes | Online forms flow gift information directly into donor records for acknowledgment and reporting.[4] |
| **Donorbox** | Yes | Yes | AI-powered CRM plus hosted donation pages.[7] |
| **Bloomerang** | Yes | Yes | Fundraising tools and CRM work together in the Bloomerang Giving Platform.[8] |
| **Givecloud** | Yes/integrates CRM | Yes | Donation forms connect to existing CRM, marketing tools, and payment processors.[9] |

If your priority is a **single system** rather than a form tool that *connects* to a CRM, **Donorbox**, **Bloomerang**, and **GivingFuel** are presented as all-in-one fundraising/CRM platforms.[1][7][8] If you already use a larger enterprise CRM, **Blackbaud CRM** is the most explicit about deep form-to-CRM syncing and constituent matching.[2]

If you want, I can narrow this to the **best option for nonprofits under a specific budget**, or compare them on **pricing, ease of use, recurring gifts, and customization**.
